Specification: This module tests various set constructor expressions in TLA+, including set comprehensions of the forms {x \in S : P(x)} and {e(x) : x \in S}, as well as set enumeration, tuples, and function set expressions. The specification defines a single variable x of type BOOLEAN, with an initial value TRUE, and a trivial next-state relation that leaves x unchanged. The main operator Inv contains a sequence of IF-THEN-ELSE assertions that check the correctness of set operations, such as membership, cardinality, and function set construction, using Assert and Print statements to indicate test results. The module is intended as a test suite for set and function constructors, not as a model of a distributed algorithm or protocol.
